Introduction
There is a gap most engineering teams discover too late. The prototype works. The demo impressed stakeholders. Someone asks, "When can we get this to production?" and the room goes quiet. Because everyone who built the thing knows the uncomfortable truth: what they demonstrated was a controlled proof of concept, not a production ready system. entry.summary: New: One stream. Now it goes everywhere you need it. Dev, staging, and prod. Real-time processing and long-term storage. No duplicate pipelines, no config drift, and no extra cost.
